title: Solving polynomial systems over non-fields and applications to modular polynomial factoring
notes: docs/problems/lifting.md. Randomized poly(d, m, log p) system solving modulo p^k for n + k constant, and states plainly that lifting singular F_p-roots is the obstruction because no general algebraic-geometry method resolves singularities efficiently. This is why the multivariate phase of the lifting problem stays closed here.
